# C54: captured policy catalogue and pinned library

The original two browser/API catalogue pages contain 62 served templates.
`library.json` records 68 templates and 62 upstream test files at MIT source
revision `8e8894fbd4cefffa3c261746bcdd70ef9fbb53a8`. The six LOGIN examples are
compatibility inputs, excluded from the served catalogue. Original response,
request, manifest, notice and provenance are retained unchanged.

## Native verification for #666

The executable REST replay pages every captured served template identity with
no duplicates or omissions. Separate pinned-source acceptance compiles all 74
programs and executes all 241 upstream test assertions, with original sources
and checksums preserved. Namespace mapping and the two test-only unsafe-wildcard
normalizations are documented in the implementation's catalogue verification.
See [expect.yaml](expect.yaml) for the executable replay binding.
